Battery Energy | ⭐ Review | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This review uniquely reframes electrodes as active ensembles governing redox thermodynamics and kinetics, not passive substrates. It consolidates metal-coating modifications for carbon/graphite felts, their synthesis, and catalytic mechanisms, while flagging metal dissolution and stability challenges. Its key novelty is positioning bismuth as the dominant, promising coating, and it signals the need for deeper mechanistic and techno-economic study.

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in hybridizing MXene with vanadium oxide to improve slurry rheology and active-material arrangement during wet spinning, enabling continuous, agglomeration-free fiber cathodes. Significance: a scalable optimization strategy for carbon-fiber-based fiber-shaped zinc-ion batteries, demonstrated powering small UAV modules.

💡 The novelty lies in a cosolvation-promotion strategy where TCPP, despite minimal Zn²⁺ coordination (0.17), boosts methanol coordination from 0.21 to 1.19 while reducing water, accelerating desolvation-coupled charge transfer at low temperature.
